selection_method: Candidates came from the normal models command, were displayed through the role-separated GUI chooser, selected as explicit LOD01 rows, and committed through the GUI confirmation callback. Project configuration was then generated by the GUI make_config method and passed to the normal CLI. No project JSON was hand-edited.
interpretation: The regular GUI model chooser, make_config path, geometry builder and Blender audit can process this unusually large 15-variant package after the user explicitly chooses an exterior and interior source. Structural import success does not establish that the guessed roles or geometry are visually correct. The high duplicate/disconnected audit counts are review hints; this run did not diagnose or correct them.
